exceptions.reason: GET /api/live upgrades to a WebSocket (Q53): the upgrade takes no params, query or body, and has no JSON reply to declare. Its plain-GET 400 is the handler's own answer, and every event it sends is checked against liveEventSchema in the hub.

The test helper keeps its name, startTestApp, rather than the skill's buildTestApp: it builds the same thing (the whole app on an in-memory database, fakes passed in), and the CLI's tests import it as @satchel/server/testing.
